purpose: Descriptive coverage, source multiplicity, and junction style distances for a target against a named reference pool; no provenance or plagiarism inference.
use_when: You hold a legitimate source pool and want to describe a target's verbatim mosaic structure.
do_not_use_when: You need an AI/human, authorship, copyright, intent, or plagiarism determination.
The likely sources are absent from the pool; low coverage cannot rule out reuse.

compute.cost_note: stdlib only; deterministic greedy span cover and bounded feature vocabulary. Hard limits of 60000 target tokens, 100000 reference tokens, and 5000 reference documents.

examples.description: Profile a target against an operator-held text directory
